pages.name: voice-denied
pages.after: (async()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Search by voice');if(!b)return 'NO VOICE BUTTON (SpeechRecognition unsupported?)';b.click();for(let i=0;i<40;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const st=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=status]')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(' | ');if(/refused|denied|not allowed|microphone/i.test(st)){const inp=document.querySelector('input[type=search],input[name=q],input[placeholder]');inp.focus();document.execCommand('insertText',false,'gloves');return {status:st,inputAfter:inp.value,buttonStill:!!b.isConnected,activeIsInput:document.activeElement===inp};}}return 'no status after 8s: '+[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=status]')].map(x=>x.textContent).join('|')})()
